title: Here’s the full workflow to build premium animated websites 🖥️🤯 #aicoding #claudeai #agenticai
description:
You can now build websites like this in minutes without any design skills.

Let me show you how it works.

First, go to motionsites ai, choose any design you like, and copy the prompt.

Then, bring it into Claude Design.

Paste the prompt, and replace it with your own idea.

In seconds, it builds a full website layout for you.

Now, here’s where it gets interesting.

To make it feel premium, you can animate the background.

Use tools like Whisk with Nano Banana, generate a visual, and turn it into a short video.

Then drop it back into Claude Design and ask it to replace the background.

And just like that, your site becomes alive.
